name: mcap-gripper-quadtile
description: MCAP gripper rig, cameras stitched into /quad_tile/compressed (express_mcap, express2)
_comment: FREQUENTLY TUNED: the video block below. Everything in it can also be given
on the command line, and an explicit flag always wins:
CRF ranges differ per encoder (x264 0-51, AV1 0-63); 0 is lossless.
See test_lerobot/REPORT.md for the codec/CRF comparison this default came from.
notes: The three cameras are crops of one mosaic, so they share a capture stamp and
a JPEG quantisation. Prefer mcap-gripper-percam when the rig is recording the
per-camera topics: the mosaic destroys native resolution and per-camera stamps.
The head tile is stored 2x upscaled inside the mosaic and is scaled back down
to 640x480 by the profile's camera_tiles, matching split_hero3_image exactly.
